title: OmniSight Release Bundle Manifest
description: Manifest describing a single deployable OmniSight release bundle. Emitted by scripts/build_image_bundle.py after CI builds the three runtime images (backend, frontend, bridge); read by /api/version at runtime so operators can prove what is actually running.

bundle_id.description: Stable identifier for this bundle. Convention: <git_ref_tail>-<short_sha> (e.g. 'v0.5.0-rc3-3f1c0a4e').

git_ref.description: Full git ref that triggered the build (e.g. 'refs/tags/v0.5.0-rc3' or 'refs/heads/develop').

git_sha.description: 40-character commit SHA the images were built from.

build_time.description: RFC 3339 / ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the bundle was sealed.

images.description: Per-image digests. Keys correspond to the three runtime planes.

contracts.description: Contract surface pinned at bake time. Lets the runtime claim 'I am compatible with frontend bundles built against api_supported, and I require at least api_required'.

api_required.description: Minimum API version the backend will negotiate with.

api_supported.description: All API versions the backend mounts simultaneously.

openapi_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the committed openapi.json at build time.

db_migration_head.description: Single alembic head the backend image was baked against.

frontend_built_against_api.description: API version the bundled frontend was built against (read from the frontend image's build metadata).

signatures.description: Optional list of detached signatures over the bundle. Populated by the signing step in CI; empty when running locally.

value.description: Signature payload or pointer (e.g. cosign rekor index, detached signature bytes base64-encoded).

key_id.description: Optional identifier for the key/identity that produced the signature.

repository.description: Optional registry/repository where the image is published (e.g. 'ghcr.io/sora-services/omnisight-backend').

tag.description: Optional tag the digest was published under at build time. Tags are mutable; digest is authoritative.
